Emirates Flight Catering (EKFC), in partnership with Microsoft, has launched the modernised Farm Manager platform, which runs operations at Emirates Bustanica, one of the world's largest indoor vertical farms. The work was led by EKFC’s in-house developers with Microsoft engineers using GitHub Copilot and agentic AI. The system supports optimising production, crop and environmental data, fewer manual processes and faster, data-led decisions. Bustanica sits at the crossroads of cutting-edge technology and the UAE's food security strategy, and this milestone reinforces its role in keeping the UAE at the forefront of agritech.
